description: This file contains extension methods for the StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> class, providing helper functions to resume stream consumption with different delegate handlers, supporting both single item and batch processing, as well as various combinations of success/error handlers and stream tokens.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to facilitate resuming stream subscriptions with delegate handlers.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (with onNextAsync, onErrorAsync, onCompletedAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream consumption using a delegate for onNext, onError, onCompleted, and optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (with onNextAsync, onErrorAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream consumption with specified handlers for onNext and onError, default onCompleted, and optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (with onNextAsync, onCompletedAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream with handlers for onNext and onCompleted, defaults for onError, optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (with onNextAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream with onNext handler only, defaults for onError and onCompleted, optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (for batch observers with onNextAsync, onErrorAsync, onCompletedAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream consumption with a batch onNext handler using IList<SequentialItem<T>>, onError, onCompleted, and optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (for batch observers with onNextAsync, onErrorAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes stream for batch observers with specified onNextAsync and onError, default onCompleted, optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (for batch observers with onNextAsync, onCompletedAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes batch stream with handlers for onNext and onCompleted, defaults for onError, optional stream token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (for batch observers with onNextAsync, token)
methods.description: Resumes batch stream with onNext handler only, defaults for onError and onCompleted, optional stream token.
